My research is motivated by a central question: **how can we empower caregivers and create systems that make high-quality educational opportunities more equitable and accessible?**

I study the full trajectory of educational opportunity: how children's homes, schools, and broader structural contexts shape their access to opportunity; how education systems can deliver high-quality programs, with attention not only to *whether* they work but to *how* they are implemented; and how families gain access to those systems in the first place. My work is interdisciplinary, uses quantitative and qualitative methods, and is conducted in partnership with education agencies in New York City and around the world. I am currently most interested in access to high-quality early childhood education.
